result.title: HIST3R: Decomposing and Rectifying State Updates with History for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
result.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://kennethyangg.github.io/HIST3R/
result.summary: Streaming 3D reconstruction with recurrent states enables long-video scene understanding under bounded memory, but turns reconstruction into a state-evolution problem: each incoming frame updates a compact scene memory on which all subsequent predictions depend, so unreliable updates overwrite historical context and accumulate into long-horizon geometric drift. We analyze CUT3R-style recurrent updates through a direction--magnitude decomposition, in which the magnitude sets the update gain, i.e., how strongly an observation is written into the state, and the direction encodes the geometric intent, i.e., where the update drives the state. This decomposition provides a unified view of CUT3R and its variants, revealing that existing training-free extensions perform magnitude-only control: they can attenuate an unreliable update but cannot correct its direction. We propose HIST3R, a training-free framework built on CUT3R that controls both components using history. HIST3R rectifies the update direction using locally consistent historical states, and modulates the update magnitude according to the visual discrepancy between the current observation and its history, suppressing redundant updates while preserving complementary evidence. Across camera pose estimation, 3D reconstruction, and video depth estimation, HIST3R consistently improves long-horizon performance while retaining the memory footprint and inference speed of CUT3R. With 1000 input frames, it reduces ATE by 23.87% on ScanNet and 33.65% on TUM-Dynamics relative to the strongest competing method; with 500 frames, it improves median reconstruction accuracy over the strongest CUT3R-based variant by 56.52% on 7-Scenes and 33.96% on NRGBD.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究流式 3D 重建中循环状态的更新可靠性问题，把 CUT3R 式状态更新分解为「幅度」与「方向」两部分，指出既有免训练扩展只调节写入幅度，进而提出用局部一致的历史状态修正更新方向、并依当前观测与历史的视觉差异调制幅度，以抑制冗余写入、保留互补证据。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽属 3D 重建而非 VLM 推理，其「状态写入增益 + 更新方向」分解与基于历史一致性/视觉差异的证据筛选门控，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的更新控制与视觉证据取舍提供可核查的机制线索，需阅读原文确认适用性。
